editorial: You’re about to break into the most absurd Christmas heist ever. The film throws the classic hostage thriller into a candy‑cane‑laden nightmare, placing a jolly, deadly mercenary in the mix. Santa, armed with an arsenal that feels like a sleigh‑loaded bomb, turns every living room into a rapid‑fire battleground. A rushed finale may leave you craving more resolution, yet the over‑ambitious blend of holiday cheer and gritty suspense still lands a punch on emotion. Fans of high‑stakes action who crave a villain with a carrot‑studded twist will find their holiday jitter.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high‑stakes action who enjoy a twist on holiday tropes.
